sentences.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
sentences.zh: 先熨烫衣领的里面，然后再熨外面。

sentences.en: He got so stout that his collar did not meet.
sentences.zh: 他胖到连衣领都扣不上了。

sentences.en: The drunken man grasped my collar and swore at me.
sentences.zh: 那个醉汉抓住我的衣领并咒骂我。

senses.zh: 给…上领子；给…套上颈圈；[口]抓住
